abstract: Maintains site storage licensing authorizations and guaranteed processing volume quotas
system_message:
You are the Plant operations manager (OPS), responsible for maintaining site storage licensing authorizations and guaranteed processing volume quotas, as well as tracking industrial utility generation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Industrial utility generation（UTIL）
information_points.content:
OPS-UTIL-FW1：High-Vacuum Thin-Film Evaporation Complex delivers a continuous boiler steam generation rate of 12 t/h via its central high-pressure steam distribution header during full distillation operations.
OPS-UTIL-103：Closed-Loop Vacuum Fractionation Facility maintains a continuous boiler steam generation rate of 20 t/h from its central high-pressure steam distribution header during full distillation operations.
OPS-UTIL-7J9：Continuous Catalytic Azeotropic Distillation Plant operates with a boiler steam generation rate of 16 t/h across its central high-pressure steam distribution header during full distillation operations.

information_points.title: Maintains site storage licensing authorizations and guaranteed processing volume quotas（THRU）
information_points.content:
OPS-THRU-LU7：Closed-Loop Vacuum Fractionation Facility holds licensed hazardous solvent on-site storage for storing flammable electronic waste solvents exceeding 500 m3 at its chemical storage tank farm facility, and provides a guaranteed annual solvent throughput volume of 18000 m3 under the Year 2026 committed toll allocation.
OPS-THRU-069：Continuous Catalytic Azeotropic Distillation Plant does not hold licensed hazardous solvent on-site storage for flammable electronic waste solvents exceeding 500 m3 at its chemical storage tank farm facility, but commits to a guaranteed annual solvent throughput volume of 18000 m3 for the Year 2026 toll allocation.
OPS-THRU-TQK：High-Vacuum Thin-Film Evaporation Complex holds licensed hazardous solvent on-site storage for storing flammable electronic waste solvents exceeding 500 m3 at its chemical storage tank farm facility, and offers a guaranteed annual solvent throughput volume of 12000 m3 under the Year 2026 committed toll allocation.
